subject: c-cont
title: (R)C.CONT.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 283 (PR.S(RD)II-37). C-CONT (composite continuance) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT (thrust continuance), WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) and TRS (transition). From TH-CONT: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From WO-EXP-PRI: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: PHI-U-P. From TRS: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From CULT-SOLD: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: PER-DY (perception dynamics).
